description_en: Reboots an Instance affected by an Operational Event
description_zh: 实例发生运维事件后，对实例进行重启操作
kebab_example: aliyun ens event-reboot-instance --event-id e-9d992570200d86b9126d78aa8c37b54b --resource-id i-50000 --ops-type immediate --plan-time 1742452232000 --plan-utc-time example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: EventRebootInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the system Event
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the operation. Valid values:

- immediate: Executes the operation immediately.

- scheduled: Executes the operation at the specified time
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务类型，取值范围：

- immediate：立即执行。

- scheduled：预约执行
parameters.name: ops_type

parameters.help_en: The scheduled execution time, as a Timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when OpsType is set to scheduled
parameters.help_zh: 预约执行时间，时间戳，单位毫秒。 当OpsType=scheduled时，此字段为必输
parameters.name: plan_time
